# Multiple files, some valid, some not — reports all errors.
! sngl check good.sngl bad.sngl
stdout 'good.sngl: ok'
stderr 'bad.sngl'

# Quiet mode suppresses ok lines.
sngl check -q good.sngl
! stdout .

# Directory discovery.
sngl check dir
stdout 'dir/a.sngl: ok'

# Nonexistent file.
! sngl check nosuch.sngl

-- good.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
}

app.window {
    main
}
-- bad.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

not valid sngl

app.window {
}
-- dir/a.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main ui {
}

app.window {
    main
}
